description: Represents a color that can be applied to text.

FromJSON.description: Converts the JSON object into the ApiColor object.

returns.description: new ApiColor object if the conversion was successful, null otherwise.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiColor class.

GetHex.description: Gets the HEX string representation of the color.

returns.description: A six-digit uppercase hex string, e.g. "FF00AA".

GetRGB.description: Gets the RGB components of the color.

GetRGBA.description: Gets the RGBA components of the color.

GetThemeName.description: Gets the theme color name if the color is a theme color.

returns.description: The theme color name or null if not a theme color.

IsAutoColor.description: Returns true if the color is set to auto.

IsThemeColor.description: Returns true if the color is a theme color.

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiColor object into the JSON object.

returns.description: JSON string representation of the color.
